__doc_model_profiles._description: Reference: model assignments per profile. Actual values are defined in code — this table is for documentation only.

execution.__doc_model_profile: Selects which model profile to use. One of: quality, balanced, budget. Each profile maps agent types (planner, executor, researcher, verifier) to Claude model tiers (opus, sonnet, haiku). See __doc_model_profiles above for the full mapping table.
execution.__doc_model_overrides: Optional per-agent-type model overrides. Keys are agent types (planner, executor, researcher, verifier) and values are model tiers (opus, sonnet, haiku). Overrides take precedence over the profile's default assignment. Example: { "executor": "opus" } upgrades the executor to opus while keeping other agents at their profile defaults.

__doc_parallelism: max_agents_per_wave  — Maximum agents spawned in a SINGLE wave.
This is the per-wave concurrency cap.
Profile max_agents   — Total agent ceiling for the selected profile
Scaled down automatically for small projects.
The effective wave size is: min(max_agents_per_wave, profile_max_agents).
Set max_agents_per_wave <= profile max_agents. If max_agents_per_wave
exceeds the profile ceiling, it is silently clamped to the profile limit.
max_agents_per_wave: 3  -> each wave runs at most 3 agents

verification.__doc_verification_profile: Verification strictness profile. One of: strict, standard, fast. strict = both gates + code review + all evidence. standard = both gates + evidence (no mandatory code review). fast = post-check only + evidence.

hooks.__doc_sound_style: Sound style for notification and completion hooks. 'system' uses OS-native system sounds (default). 'bundled' uses MaxsimCLI's custom chime sounds (pleasant ascending tones).
hooks.__doc_sound_volume: Volume for bundled sounds (0–100). Only applies when sound_style is 'bundled'. System sounds always play at OS volume. Default: 50.
